When it's worth it
Effort controls
Many providers let you set reasoning effort or thinking budgets, balancing accuracy against cost and latency.
Measure
Compare cost per correct answer, not cost per request: if a reasoning model solves a task first time where a cheaper model needs three attempts and human fixes, it may be cheaper overall.
Use reasoning selectively, routed to the tasks that need it.

cards.title: Mesurer le coût par résultat
cards.text: Suivez le coût par ticket résolu, par facture traitée ou par rapport, et pas seulement par token. Un modèle plus cher qui exige moins d'essais et de corrections peut revenir moins cher au total.

deep.x: Token prices are inputs; business value is measured per outcome: resolved tickets, processed invoices, completed reports.

v.f: cost per outcome = (model + infrastructure + human review) ÷ successful outcomes

deep.x: Example
Full picture
Comparing with the baseline
If an invoice used to take 6 minutes of staff time and now takes 1 minute of review plus €0.05 of AI, the saving is clear even with premium models.
Optimising for cheapest tokens can increase total cost if quality drops and humans must fix more.

cards.title: Les prix continuent de baisser

viz.unit: prix relatif pour une capacité similaire (illustratif)

cards.text: Le prix d'un niveau de capacité donné a chuté spectaculairement d'année en année. Des projets qui paraissent trop coûteux aujourd'hui pourraient être abordables l'an prochain.

deep.x: The cost of a given capability level has fallen dramatically, driven by better hardware, efficient models, competition and inference optimisations.

v.unit: price for GPT-3.5-level capability, $ per million tokens (approx.)

deep.x: Implications

items: Revisit use cases rejected as too costly
Avoid long fixed-price commitments without review

deep.x: Jevons paradox
As AI gets cheaper per task, organisations use it for more tasks, so total spend often rises even as unit costs fall.
Frontier stays expensive
While old capability levels get cheap, the newest, most capable models remain premium-priced.
Plan for falling unit prices and rising usage at the same time.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce qui coûte généralement plus cher par token ?
quiz.explain: La génération coûte plus cher.

quiz.q: Quelle option est moins chère pour des gros traitements non urgents ?
quiz.explain: Le traitement par lots sacrifie la vitesse au profit du prix.

quiz.q: Qu'améliore le streaming ?
options: La rapidité perçue de la réponse par l'utilisateur
quiz.explain: Le texte s'affiche au fur et à mesure de sa génération.

lessons.title: IA multimodale
lessons.summary: Des modèles qui voient, entendent et parlent.

cards.title: Un modèle, de nombreuses entrées
cards.text: Les modèles multimodaux acceptent du texte, des images, de l'audio et parfois de la vidéo dans une même conversation, et peuvent répondre en texte, en parole ou en images.

deep.x: Natively multimodal models are trained on text, images, audio and video together, rather than bolting separate systems together. They can reason across modalities: relate a chart to a report, or a photo to a manual.
How images become tokens
Images are split into patches, encoded into embeddings, and placed in the same sequence as text tokens, so the model attends across both.
Milestones

events.l: real-time voice and native multimodal models

deep.x: Benefits

x: Fewer pipeline steps, fewer errors from conversions
Natural interfaces: show and tell instead of typing

deep.x: An image can consume as many tokens as a page of text, so multimodal requests cost accordingly.

cards.title: Lire les documents visuellement
cards.text: Les modèles de vision lisent directement sur image des documents scannés, des formulaires, des tableaux et des graphiques, en gérant souvent des mises en page qui faisaient échouer l'ancien OCR.

deep.x: Vision-capable models read documents as images, interpreting layout, tables, stamps, handwriting and checkboxes, which traditional OCR pipelines often mangled.
Compared with classic OCR
Accuracy tips

items: Ask for structured output with field-level confidence

deep.x: Hybrid pipelines
Some systems combine fast OCR for raw text with a multimodal model for layout understanding and tricky fields.

steps: Multimodal model for layout and fields

deep.x: For commodity logistics, reading certificates of origin, quality certificates and bills of lading is a strong multimodal use case.

cards.title: Comprendre les photos
cards.text: Montrez la photo d'une pièce cassée, d'une maladie de plante, d'un tableau blanc ou d'un tableau électrique et posez vos questions. Utile pour les techniciens de terrain et les inspections, avec vérification humaine.

deep.x: Multimodal models can interpret photos: identifying objects, reading labels, describing damage, and answering questions about what they see.
Workflow example

steps: Model reads nameplate and identifies issue

deep.x: Limits
Safety-critical use
For electrical, medical or structural assessments, treat model output as a hint for a qualified person, not a decision.

items: final safety decisions without expert check

deep.x: Photographing a fuse board and asking which circuit is which can save time, but always confirm with a tester before working on circuits.

cards.title: Graphiques et tableaux de bord
cards.text: Les modèles peuvent décrire et analyser des graphiques à partir de captures d'écran, mais risquent de mal lire les valeurs exactes. Pour des chiffres précis, utilisez les données sous-jacentes.

deep.x: Models can interpret charts from images, describing trends, comparing series and extracting approximate values. Exact numbers are less reliable.
Best practice

items: Provide the underlying data when precision matters
Ask for ranges rather than exact readings

deep.x: Generating charts
Rather than generating chart images, assistants with code tools create charts from data accurately, which you can then refine.
Dashboards
Screenshots of dashboards can be summarised for executives, but connecting the model directly to the data source is more reliable.
For decisions, use the data; for quick understanding, a chart screenshot works.

cards.title: Compréhension vidéo
cards.text: Certains modèles peuvent regarder une vidéo et la résumer, trouver des moments ou répondre à des questions, ce qui sert pour les contenus de formation, les réunions et les inspections.

deep.x: Video models sample frames and audio to answer questions, summarise content, find specific moments and describe actions.
Long videos
Long videos consume many tokens; models sample frames at intervals, so very brief events may be missed.
Combining with transcripts
Pairing visual analysis with speech transcripts gives the richest understanding: what was said and what was shown.
Privacy
Video often contains identifiable people; apply data protection rules and consent requirements.
Some models can process an hour of video in a single request thanks to million-token context windows.

cards.title: Voix en temps réel
cards.text: Les modes vocaux permettent de parler naturellement avec l'assistant, de l'interrompre et d'obtenir des réponses parlées, pratique au volant ou quand on a les mains occupées.

deep.x: Real-time voice modes let you converse naturally with an assistant, with low latency, interruptions and expressive speech.

items.b: for those who find typing hard

deep.x: Behind the scenes
Native speech-to-speech models process audio directly, preserving tone and enabling quick turn-taking, unlike older systems that transcribed, thought in text and then spoke.
Tips

items: Ask it to keep answers brief
Switch to text for complex outputs like tables

deep.x: Caution
Avoid sharing sensitive information aloud in public spaces, and remember voice recordings may be stored depending on settings.
Voice turns AI into a conversation partner you can use while your hands are busy.

cards.title: Génération d'images dans le chat
cards.text: Les assistants multimodaux peuvent créer et retoucher des images au sein de la conversation : schémas, maquettes, illustrations, ajustés par des demandes successives.

deep.x: Modern assistants can generate and edit images in the conversation, keeping context: you can refine a diagram or mock-up through follow-up messages.

steps: "Make the arrows blue and add labels"

deep.x: Uses
Improved text rendering
Native multimodal image generation follows instructions and renders text far better than earlier diffusion models, making it useful for posters and diagrams, though details still need checking.

items: struggled with text and complex instructions

deep.x: Brand and rights
Generated visuals for external use should follow brand guidelines and licence terms of the tool.
Being able to say "keep everything, just change the background" made iterative image work far more practical.

cards.title: Accessibilité

items: Lecture de texte à voix haute

cards.text: L'IA multimodale décrit les images pour les personnes aveugles ou malvoyantes, lit le texte à voix haute et transcrit la parole pour les personnes sourdes, ce qui élargit l'accès à l'information.

deep.x: Multimodal AI expands access to information for people with disabilities.

items.b: describe photos, read signs and documents

deep.x: Real apps
Apps like Be My Eyes integrated multimodal AI in 2023, letting blind users get detailed descriptions of their surroundings, products and screens.
Inclusive design
Limits
AI descriptions can be wrong; for critical tasks like medication labels, users may still want human verification.
Accessibility features often help everyone: captions, summaries and voice control are widely used beyond their original audience.

cards.title: Limites
cards.text: Les modèles peuvent mal lire du petit texte, mal compter des objets, confondre des éléments proches ou se laisser tromper par des images inhabituelles. Vérifiez tout ce qui touche à la sécurité.

deep.x: Multimodal models have characteristic failure modes worth knowing.

items: Confusing left and right or spatial relations

deep.x: Visual hallucination
Models may "see" things that aren't there, especially when prompts suggest them ("describe the dog in this photo" when there's no dog).

items.r: "Is there a defect? If so, describe it, if not, say none is visible"

deep.x: Adversarial images
Text hidden in images can act as prompt injection, instructing the model to do something unintended.
Testing
Evaluate on your real images, including poor lighting and unusual angles, before relying on visual analysis.
Asking neutral questions instead of leading ones noticeably reduces visual hallucinations.

cards.title: Vie privée et images
cards.text: Les photos peuvent contenir des visages, des plaques d'immatriculation, des documents ou des lieux. Vérifiez ce que vous partagez, surtout au travail.

deep.x: Images carry more personal data than people realise: faces, licence plates, documents in the background, screens, location metadata.
Workplace rules
Reduce exposure
Biometric data
Facial images processed to identify people are biometric data, a special category under GDPR with strict rules.
Before uploading a photo, scan it for anything you wouldn't want to share.

quiz.q: Que peuvent accepter les modèles multimodaux ?
options: Du texte, des images, de l'audio et parfois de la vidéo
quiz.explain: Plusieurs types d'entrées.

quiz.q: Pour obtenir les chiffres exacts d'un graphique, mieux vaut…
options: Se fier à une capture d'écran
quiz.explain: Les captures d'écran donnent des approximations.

quiz.q: Quelle est une limite des modèles de vision ?
options: Mal compter ou mal lire de petits détails
quiz.explain: Vérifiez les détails critiques pour la sécurité.

lessons.title: Risques et usage responsable
lessons.summary: Mésusage, biais, propriété intellectuelle et protection des personnes.

cards.title: Une carte des risques
cards.text: Les risques comprennent les réponses fausses, les productions biaisées, la fuite de données confidentielles, les questions de droit d'auteur, les deepfakes et la fraude, le détournement à des fins nuisibles et la dépendance excessive des utilisateurs.

deep.x: Generative AI risks span technical, legal, ethical and organisational dimensions. Frameworks like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (2023) and ISO/IEC 42001 (2023) help organise them.
Likelihood and impact
Risk management cycle
Proportionality
Controls should match risk: lightweight for internal brainstorming, rigorous for customer-facing or decision-making systems.
A use-case inventory with risk ratings is the foundation of AI governance.

cards.title: Fuite de données
cards.text: Coller des données confidentielles dans des outils d'IA grand public peut les envoyer hors de votre organisation. Utilisez des outils d'entreprise approuvés, qui n'entraînent pas leurs modèles sur vos données et respectent vos exigences de sécurité.

deep.x: Data leakage happens when confidential or personal information reaches places it shouldn't: external providers without agreements, other users, logs or model training.

items: data may be retained or used per consumer terms

deep.x: Incidents
In 2023 Samsung engineers reportedly pasted confidential source code into a public chatbot, leading the company to restrict such tools.
Leakage paths
Controls
Banning AI tools outright often drives usage underground; providing safe approved tools is more effective.

cards.title: Biais

items: Relecture humaine des décisions sur les personnes

cards.text: Les modèles reflètent les motifs de leurs données d'entraînement et peuvent produire des résultats stéréotypés ou inégaux. Testez les résultats selon les groupes pour les usages touchant des personnes, comme le recrutement ou le crédit.

deep.x: Generative models can reproduce stereotypes: assuming professions' genders, under-representing groups in images, or treating dialects and names differently.

items: Different tone by names or dialects

deep.x: Testing

steps: Create matched prompts varying only group attributes

deep.x: High-stakes uses
Using generative AI to screen CVs, assess employees or evaluate creditworthiness falls into high-risk categories under the EU AI Act, requiring rigorous bias testing and oversight.
Mitigations
Test with the people your system will serve, in the languages they use.

cards.title: Propriété intellectuelle

items: Chercher les copies mot pour mot

cards.text: Des questions subsistent sur l'entraînement avec des œuvres protégées et sur la propriété des productions de l'IA. Vérifiez que le texte ou le code généré ne reproduit pas de contenu protégé, et suivez la politique de votre entreprise.

deep.x: IP risks run both ways: outputs may infringe others' rights, and your inputs may expose your own IP.

items.b: generated text or code resembling protected works

deep.x: Code assistants
Some coding tools offer filters that block suggestions matching public code, and vendors may offer indemnities against copyright claims.

items: Keep human authorship in key work
Document AI use for important assets

deep.x: Copyright of outputs
In many places, purely AI-generated outputs may not be protected by copyright; meaningful human creative contribution matters.

items: publishing AI output that mirrors a known work

deep.x: Several major AI providers offer enterprise customers legal indemnity for copyright claims arising from model outputs, under conditions.

cards.title: Dépendance excessive
cards.text: On a tendance à trop faire confiance à une IA fluide et sûre d'elle, une forme de biais d'automatisation. Gardez les humains impliqués et responsables, surtout pour les décisions importantes.

deep.x: Automation bias leads people to accept AI outputs without enough scrutiny, especially when they're fluent, fast and usually right.
Evidence

A 2023 Harvard–BCG study found consultants using AI performed much better on tasks within AI's capabilities, but were more likely to get wrong answers on a task just outside them, trusting flawed outputs.
Deskilling
Relying on AI for tasks you never learn can leave you unable to spot errors. Deliberate practice and understanding remain important.
Countermeasures

items: Require brief human reasoning for key decisions
Train staff on AI failure modes

deep.x: The "jagged frontier": AI is excellent at some tasks and poor at similar-looking ones; know where the edges are.

cards.title: Protections contre le mésusage
cards.text: Les fournisseurs entraînent leurs modèles à refuser les demandes clairement nuisibles et surveillent les abus, notamment autour des armes, des cyberattaques et de la protection de l'enfance. Les tentatives de contournement (jailbreak) sont un jeu du chat et de la souris permanent.

deep.x: Model providers apply layered safeguards against misuse: training models to refuse harmful requests, classifiers detecting dangerous content, usage policies and abuse monitoring.
Priority risks
Jailbreaks
Users try role-play, encoding and multi-step tricks to bypass refusals. Providers patch vulnerabilities and run bug bounties; it's an ongoing contest.
Balance
Good safeguards minimise both harm and unnecessary refusals, allowing legitimate medical, security and research questions while blocking real uplift for attackers.
Providers report regularly on misuse they've detected and disrupted, such as influence operations and scam networks.

cards.title: Transparence

items: Expliquer les décisions assistées par IA

cards.text: Informez les gens quand ils interagissent avec une IA ou lisent un contenu généré par IA, lorsque cela compte. Le règlement européen sur l'IA l'exige pour les chatbots et les deepfakes.

deep.x: Transparency about AI use supports trust, informed choice and accountability.

items.b: document AI involvement in key work

deep.x: Legal requirements
The EU AI Act requires informing people they're interacting with an AI system (unless obvious), and labelling deepfakes and certain AI-generated public-interest text.
Practical approaches
When disclosure matters most
Honest disclosure rarely hurts trust; discovering undisclosed AI use often does.

cards.title: Empreinte environnementale

items: Préférer les centres de données renouvelables

cards.text: Entraîner et exécuter de grands modèles consomme beaucoup d'électricité et d'eau de refroidissement. Des modèles efficaces, un bon dimensionnement et une énergie propre réduisent l'empreinte.

deep.x: Generative AI uses energy for training and, increasingly, for inference at massive scale, plus water for cooling data centres and resources for chips.
Context
Estimates per request have fallen as hardware and models improve; recent provider disclosures put a typical text query at fractions of a watt-hour. Total demand still grows with usage.
Reducing footprint

items: Don't generate what you won't use

deep.x: Corporate reporting
Companies increasingly include AI-related emissions in sustainability reporting under rules like the EU's CSRD.
Training one frontier model can use as much electricity as thousands of homes for a year, but daily global use now likely exceeds training energy.

cards.title: Politiques au travail
cards.text: Les bonnes politiques d'IA sont courtes et pratiques : quels outils sont approuvés, quelles données peuvent être utilisées, quand une relecture humaine est requise et comment signaler un problème.

deep.x: An effective AI policy enables safe use rather than just prohibiting. Keep it short, clear and updated.

items: Approved tools and how to access them
Data rules: what may and may not be entered

deep.x: Data traffic light

items.b: highly confidential or personal data, specific approved systems only

deep.x: Training
Pair policy with practical training: examples of good use, common mistakes and how to verify outputs. The EU AI Act requires adequate AI literacy for staff using AI.
Governance roles
Assign owners: an AI governance group, data protection officer, security and business sponsors for each major use case.
A one-page policy people actually read beats a fifty-page document nobody follows.

cards.title: Utiliser l'IA pour aider, pas pour tromper
cards.text: Utilisez l'IA générative pour mieux travailler, pas pour fabriquer de fausses preuves, usurper l'identité de quelqu'un ou induire en erreur. La franchise sur l'usage de l'IA instaure la confiance avec collègues et clients.

deep.x: The ethical line is less about whether AI was used and more about honesty: not misleading others about facts, authorship or identity.
Examples of misuse

items: Submitting AI work as solely your own where prohibited

deep.x: Professional integrity
Many professions now issue guidance: lawyers must verify citations, journalists disclose AI use, academics follow journal rules on AI authorship.
Building trust

items.b: when it matters to the reader

deep.x: Fake AI-generated reviews are now explicitly targeted by consumer protection rules in the EU and US.

quiz.q: Quel est le principal risque de coller des données confidentielles dans un chatbot grand public ?
options: Les données peuvent quitter l'organisation ou servir à l'entraînement
quiz.explain: Utilisez des outils d'entreprise approuvés.

quiz.q: Qu'est-ce que le biais d'automatisation ?
options: Faire trop confiance aux résultats automatisés
quiz.explain: On a tendance à trop se fier à une IA fluide.

quiz.q: Qu'exige le règlement européen sur l'IA pour les chatbots ?
options: Informer les utilisateurs qu'ils interagissent avec une IA
quiz.explain: Des obligations de transparence.

lessons.title: Bien utiliser l'IA générative
lessons.summary: Des habitudes pratiques pour le travail quotidien.

cards.title: Commencez par vos goulots d'étranglement
cards.text: Listez les tâches qui vous prennent du temps et sont riches en texte : e-mails, rapports, résumés, comptes rendus de réunion, recherches, tableurs. C'est généralement là que l'IA aide en premier.

deep.x: The best first uses of AI are tasks you do often, that take real time and involve text or information processing.
Prioritise
Track your time
For a week, note tasks that feel repetitive or slow. Then test AI on the top three and measure time saved.
Start small
Pick one workflow, refine it until it works reliably, then expand.
Focus on workflows, not features: where does your time actually go?

cards.title: Rédiger, sans déléguer aveuglément

items: Brouillon IA : structure et premier jet

cards.text: Utilisez l'IA pour les premiers 70 à 80 % et consacrez votre énergie à ce qui exige votre jugement : décisions, nuances, relations.

deep.x: AI accelerates the first draft; your expertise turns it into something good. The goal is better work in less time, not outsourcing judgement.
A good division of labour
Quality tip
Give the AI your key points and reasoning first; it then structures and expresses them, instead of inventing positions.
AI-assisted work should still sound like you and reflect your thinking.

cards.title: Résumer pour décider

items.r: « résume pour décider : options, coûts, risques, questions »

cards.text: Demandez des résumés qui aident à décider : « Quelles sont les trois options, les coûts et risques de chacune, et que manque-t-il ? »

deep.x: Generic summaries compress; decision-focused summaries help you act. Tell the AI what decision you face.

items.r: "Summarise for a go/no-go decision: options, costs, risks, open questions"

deep.x: Useful summary formats

items: Options with pros, cons and costs

deep.x: Executive summaries
For leaders, ask for a one-paragraph bottom line up front, then supporting bullets, then details if needed.
Verify the basis
Ask the summary to reference which sections support each point, so you can check before deciding.
Asking "what would make this recommendation wrong?" surfaces assumptions summaries often hide.

cards.title: Apprendre plus vite
cards.text: L'IA est un tuteur patient : demandez-lui d'expliquer un concept à différents niveaux, de vous interroger ou de donner des exemples de votre domaine.

deep.x: AI tutors adapt explanations to your level, answer follow-ups instantly and generate practice questions.
Techniques

items: "Explain like I'm new to this, then like an expert"

deep.x: Research supports active learning
Studies of AI tutoring found students learned more when the AI guided them through problems rather than giving answers directly.
Verify as you learn
Cross-check key facts with reliable sources, especially in unfamiliar fields where you can't spot errors.
Use AI to make you think more, not less: ask it to question you.

cards.title: Analyser des données

steps: L'IA écrit et exécute du code

cards.text: Avec un interpréteur de code, l'IA peut nettoyer des tableurs, faire des calculs et tracer des graphiques. Vérifiez le code et les chiffres avant de partager les résultats.

deep.x: With code execution, assistants clean data, compute statistics, build charts and explain findings, letting non-programmers do real analysis.
Good prompts for analysis

items: Describe the columns and their meaning
Ask for assumptions to be listed

deep.x: Common pitfalls
Verify
Reconcile totals with known figures, spot-check a few rows, and review the code if the result matters.
Asking the AI to "first describe the dataset and any data quality issues" often reveals problems before analysis begins.

cards.title: Mieux écrire, avec votre voix

items: Demander de clarifier pour le public

cards.text: Donnez à l'IA des échantillons de vos textes et demandez-lui d'en reprendre le style. Demandez-lui de resserrer, clarifier ou rendre un texte plus direct.

deep.x: AI can match your style if you show it examples, and improve clarity without making text generic.

items: Ask for specific edits: shorter, clearer, more direct
Review for anything that doesn't sound like you

deep.x: Editing modes

items.b: same message for a different audience

deep.x: Avoid the generic AI voice
Overused phrases and excessive enthusiasm make text sound machine-written. Ask for plain, specific language and remove filler.

items.w: "In today's fast-paced world, it's crucial to leverage synergies"
items.r: "We can save two weeks by sharing the test team"

deep.x: Multilingual
AI helps write in other languages, but have important texts reviewed by a fluent speaker, especially for European Portuguese nuances.
Use AI as an editor that sharpens your voice, not one that replaces it.

cards.title: Préparer les réunions

steps: Avant : synthèse et ordre du jour

cards.text: Avant une réunion, demandez une note de synthèse à partir des documents pertinents, les questions probables et un ordre du jour proposé. Après, transformez vos notes en actions à mener.

deep.x: AI can turn scattered documents into a focused briefing and turn meetings into clear outcomes.
Before the meeting
After the meeting
Negotiations
Role-playing a negotiation with AI, asking it to play the counterpart, helps you anticipate arguments and refine your position.
Sending a crisp summary with decisions and owners within an hour of a meeting dramatically improves follow-through.

cards.title: Savoir personnel
cards.text: Gardez les bons prompts dans une bibliothèque, enregistrez les résultats utiles et créez de petits assistants réutilisables (GPT personnalisés, projets Claude, agents Copilot) pour les tâches répétitives.

deep.x: Building a personal AI toolkit, with saved prompts, reusable assistants and organised references, compounds productivity over time.
Custom assistants
Organising knowledge
Keep key reference documents (style guides, product facts, glossaries) ready to attach, so assistants work from accurate context.
Share with your team
Sharing effective prompts and assistants spreads good practice and saves everyone time.
Every time you write a great prompt, save it; that's how expertise accumulates.

cards.title: Savoir quand s'en passer
cards.text: N'utilisez pas l'IA quand l'exactitude est critique et invérifiable, quand la confidentialité l'interdit, ou quand le lien humain est l'essentiel, comme dans les conversations délicates.

deep.x: AI is a powerful tool, but some situations call for restraint.
Human connection
Condolence messages, difficult feedback and personal apologies carry weight because they come from you. AI can help you think, but the words should be yours.
Verification cost test
If checking the AI's output would take as long as doing the task yourself, and errors matter, AI may not save time.

items.b: do it yourself or with experts

deep.x: Confidentiality
When in doubt about data sensitivity, don't paste it; ask your data protection or security team.
People report AI is most useful for tasks they already know well enough to judge the result.

cards.title: Continuer à progresser

steps: Y revenir quand les outils progressent

cards.text: Les outils s'améliorent tous les quelques mois. Revenez sur les tâches qui ne fonctionnaient pas avant, partagez vos astuces avec vos collègues et gardez quelques expériences en cours.

deep.x: AI tools change fast. Habits of regular experimentation keep your skills current.
Habits

items: Monthly: retry a task that failed before
Keep a log of useful prompts
Follow a couple of trusted sources

deep.x: Measuring your progress
Team learning
Communities of practice, short demos and shared libraries spread skills across organisations faster than formal training alone.
Stay critical
Enthusiasm and scepticism both have a place: test claims on your own work, and keep human judgement at the centre.
The best way to understand AI is to use it thoughtfully, every week.
